question: When source and target benchmark defect families differ, can prequential target-only feedback improve equal-budget verifier routing without looking at future target outcomes?

workspacebench: Only reannotation rows labelled 已确认·确定性矛盾 are eligible.
Only placeholder_leak maps one-to-one onto a frozen probe family without relying on WorkspaceBench output_files as a gold contract.
gdpval: Only audit violations with evidence_tier=confirmed are eligible.
Each confirmed violation is mapped to one frozen structural probe family from its defect type and replay message.
jobbench: The absence of findings is not treated as a clean label.
JobBench is excluded from quantitative online-policy evaluation.

allowed_before_each_target_item: probe applicability derived from field/capability presence
outcomes of probes executed on earlier target items
forbidden_before_each_target_item: current or future target finding labels
current or future target verifier outcomes
target task or rubric text values

policies.R_random_static: One random family order per permutation, fixed across all target items.
policies.R_random_per_item: Fresh random applicable probes per target item.
policies.D_source_memory: Static order by source confirmed finding yield.
policies.H_online_ucb1: Target-only UCB1; updates occur after the selected probes for an item execute.
policies.I_memory_seeded_ucb1: The same UCB1 policy with one weak source-derived pseudo-observation per source-supported family.

interpretation_gate.reason: Both labelled target benchmarks were used during exploratory development and JobBench has no independent defect labels.
interpretation_gate.required_next_step: Freeze an independently labelled unseen benchmark or new confirmed trace corpus before making a generalization claim.
